label_rule.Strong: top line +15% or more AND profit +20% or more YoY, margin not down more than 100 bps
label_rule.Good: top line and profit both up 5% or more YoY
label_rule.Weak: profit down 10% or more YoY, or top line and profit both down, or turned to loss
label_rule.Mixed: everything else with both growth figures known
label_rule.—: growth not computable (no year-ago quarter, or a loss in the year-ago quarter)
